sentences.en: Everybody was disguised, so I couldn't tell who was who.
sentences.zh: 每个人都打扮成别的样子，所以我分辨不出谁是谁。

sentences.en: Quite a few people couldn't recognize him in that disguise.
sentences.zh: 不少人认不出他那个装扮下的模样。

sentences.en: He disguised himself as Santa Claus to please his children.
sentences.zh: 为了取悦孩子们，他把自己扮成了圣诞老人。
